definitions.name: Airtable List Bases (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/meta/bases. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE CREATE-TABLE", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/meta/bases/{baseId}/views. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. definitions.name: Airtable List Records (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. Sources: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/scopes https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-base https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/field-model https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-view-metadata https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-comments https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-collaborators https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/individual-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/group-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/user-mentioned https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/table-model

definitions.name: Airtable Get Record (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. Sources: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/scopes https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-base https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/field-model https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-view-metadata https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-comments https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-collaborators https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/individual-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/group-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/user-mentioned https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/table-model

definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE CREATE-RECORD", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. Sources: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/scopes https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-base https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/field-model https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-view-metadata https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-comments https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-collaborators https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/individual-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/group-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/user-mentioned https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/table-model

definitions.name: Airtable Create Records (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE CREATE-RECORDS", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. Sources: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/scopes https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-base https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/field-model https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-view-metadata https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-comments https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-collaborators https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/individual-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/group-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/user-mentioned https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/table-model

definitions.name: Airtable Update Record (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PATCH https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. definitions.name: Airtable Replace Record (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE REPLACE-RECORD", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. Sources: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/scopes https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-base https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/field-model https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-view-metadata https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-comments https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-collaborators https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/individual-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/group-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/user-mentioned https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/table-model

definitions.name: Airtable Update Records (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PATCH https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE UPDATE-RECORDS", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. definitions.documentation:
PUT https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE REPLACE-RECORDS", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. Sources: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/scopes https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-base https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/field-model https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-view-metadata https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-comments https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-collaborators https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/individual-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/group-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/user-mentioned https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/table-model

definitions.documentation:
PATCH https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE UPSERT-RECORDS", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. Sources: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/scopes https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-base https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/field-model https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-view-metadata https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-comments https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-collaborators https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/individual-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/group-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/user-mentioned https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/table-model

definitions.name: Airtable Delete Record (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE DELETE-RECORD", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. Sources: https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/scopes https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-base https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/field-model https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-view-metadata https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-multiple-records https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-comments https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-comment https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-collaborators https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/individual-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/group-collaborator https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/user-mentioned https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/model/table-model

definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE DELETE-RECORDS", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. definitions.documentation:
GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}/comments. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments. POST https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableIdOrName}/{recordId}/comments. One request, caller-controlled pagination; no automatic retry including HTTP 429. PAT scopes or externally supplied OAuth token must grant the endpoint and base access. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="AIRTABLE CREATE-COMMENT", and $retries=0. Total deadline starts before profile and secret resolution; fixed HTTPS origin, manual redirects, bounded UTF-8 JSON. Attachment URLs are metadata only; this node never downloads attachments.
